Prettier never reaches a fixed point on this input. The comment on the default's `=`
line with the member value below it (`x = // c⏎(a as any).b`) oscillates forever with
the cast operand re-wrapped in an expanded shell that holds the comment
(`x = ( // c⏎a as any⏎).b`), flipping on every pass; the conditional case settles
with the comment floated past the value (`x = (a as any) ? b : c // c`) but never
frees the file. No prettier-anchored claim file (output_prettier.*, audit_signature.txt,
variants) is expressible. The validator live-verifies this claim (rule F5). tsv keeps
the comment on the `=` line and hangs the value one level under it, its one fixed
point. See README.md and docs/conformance_prettier_ts_comments.md §Comment relocation.
